AutoRest names parameters according to the hierachy of the underlying parameters in the swagger spec. This may lead to unnecessarily complex parameters such as `InvitedUserDetailAuthType` and `InvitedUserDetailInvitedEmail`. Consider renaming them with the rename directive.

This applies to many parameters in many other cmdlets. Please take a full pass.

https://github.com/Azure/autorest.powershell/blob/main/docs/directives.md#Parameter-Rename

discussion_comments.comment_body:
```suggestion
      verb: New|Update
```

`Update-AzQuota` still have this weird parameter name as `-NameValue`.

Usually when designing cmdlets for an async operation on the cloud we would use a combination of cmdlets - `Start-***Job`, `Stop-***Job`, `Get-*Job`.

If the operation is synchonous, (I believe this cmdlet is), we usually use `Invoke-`.

So consider renaming this cmdlet `Invoke-AzNetworkCloudStorageApplianceReadCommand`
